parts.question: German AX-17 guidance before latest revision?

result.answer: The superseded German AX-17 Product Information v3.8 (DE-AX17-LBL-038), in effect from 2025-02-03 to 2026-09-15, specified historical renal dosing as follows: normal starting dose was 50 mg OD [E2], mild starting dose was 50 mg OD [E2], moderate starting dose was 50 mg OD [E2] (or 50 mg once daily [E3]), and severe was not recommended [E2]. Historical scanned safety letters were also in effect from 2019-01-01 to 2022-01-01 [E5].
